page.title: %s – %s
nav.label: Main
layout.help: Need help? Contact your company's ERP administrator.
language.name: English
home.title: Your workspace
home.notice.title: The jobs' screens are coming
home.notice.body: You are signed in. The screens for the pilot's jobs follow in the next versions of the workspace.
home.jobs.title: Coming to the workspace

home.jobs.count.one: %d job is planned for the pilot.
home.jobs.count.other: %d jobs are planned for the pilot.

status.title: Service status
notfound.title: Page not found
notfound.body: The page you asked for does not exist, or is not yours to see.
home.companies.title: Your companies
home.companies.none: You have no company to work in yet. Ask your company's ERP administrator for access.
signin.title: Sign in
signin.lead: Enter your company's sign-in code. You will then sign in at your company's own identity provider.
signin.code.label: Sign-in code
signin.code.hint: Your administrator gives you the code. It is also the last part of the sign-in address you were sent.
signin.invalid: A sign-in code has 2 to 32 lower-case letters, digits and hyphens.
signin.unknown: No company uses this sign-in code. Check it with your administrator.
signin.error.title: There is a problem
signin.failed.title: Sign-in could not be completed
signin.failed.body: Your company's identity provider did not confirm the sign-in, or it took too long. Start again.
signin.unavailable: Signing in is not possible right now. Try again in a few minutes.
signin.stepup.body: Your company requires a second factor for this, and your identity provider did not confirm one. Sign in again with your second factor.
continue.title: Continue to your workspace
continue.body: Your browser is taking you to the page. If nothing happens, use the link.
signedout.title: You are signed out
signedout.body: Your session in the workspace has ended. To be sure no one else can use it, close the browser if you share this computer.
refused.title: This request was refused
refused.body: It did not carry the page's security token, or it came from another site. Go back, reload the page and try again.
inbox.title: Approvals waiting for you
inbox.lead: The requests you may decide now, newest first. Open one to see its steps and decide it.
inbox.empty: Nothing is waiting for your decision.
inbox.list.label: Requests waiting for you
inbox.barred.title: Your approvals are on hold
inbox.barred.body: You hold permissions that a segregation-of-duties rule keeps apart, so you cannot use them until an administrator removes one of them:
inbox.done.title: Decision recorded
inbox.refused.title: The approval requests could not be shown
agent.text: An agent wrote this. It is shown as plain text: check it before you decide.
request.title: Approval request
decide.title: Your decision
decide.comment.label: Comment (optional)
decide.comment.hint: At most 2,000 characters. It is recorded with your approval.
decide.reason.label: Reason for rejecting
decide.reason.hint: Required, at most 2,000 characters. The requester sees it.
decide.comment.long: A comment has at most 2,000 characters.
decide.own: You asked for this approval. Someone else decides it.
decide.notyours: You may not decide this request: it needs the step's role and the permission to approve this kind of object.
decide.closed: Nothing is left to decide: the request is no longer waiting.
refusal.title: The decision was not recorded
problem.workflow.already_approved: You have already approved this request. The next approval is someone else's.
problem.workflow.not_pending: This request is no longer waiting for a decision.
problem.workflow.own_request: You asked for this approval, so you cannot decide it.
problem.workflow.role_missing: You do not hold the role this step needs.
problem.workflow.segregation_of_duties: You took part in this work, so segregation of duties keeps you from approving it.
problem.workflow.request_pending: Another approval for the same object is still waiting.
problem.request.version_mismatch: The request changed since you opened it. Check it again, then decide.
problem.identity.permission_missing: You do not have the permission this needs.
problem.identity.sod_conflict: A segregation-of-duties rule bars this: you hold permissions it keeps apart.
problem.identity.agent_not_allowed: Only a person may decide approvals.
problem.request.not_found: The request does not exist, or is not yours to see.
problem.request.invalid_body: The decision could not be read. Reload the page and try again.
problem.request.validation_failed: Something in the decision is not valid. Check the comment and try again.
problem.request.idempotency_key_reused: This form was already sent with other content. Reload the page and decide again.
problem.ledger.period_not_open: The posting period is not open, so the entry cannot be posted on approval.
